title: Giấc mơ nhỏ
about: Round 33, ke-chuyen-gan ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác album mới, theo phong cách ambient và dễ ngủ"), for a new album, Những giấc mơ nhỏ: a small dream, the title piece, written to close the album: D major at 52 bpm, the softest, with no strings' chords in the middle, only the violas' thin line. Its motif leans down a step and settles (F#-E-D, E-C#), as breath slows; the middle in B minor reaches B5 once. Written to sleep to, on the sound the user settled on (ke-chuyen-gan: the piano near, a wide hall, a soft echo): its tune moves by step and stays low, its sentences come back with small changes (each middle section 16 bars, a sentence and its variation), the left hand rocks in eighths through most of it, the climax stays low. An original tune.
